Bhide tries to introduce himself as the society secretary and teacher to explain the situation, while Babita clarifies that the car was a wedding anniversary gift from Iyer. Unmoved, Chalu Pandey assumes they are all part of a stolen car racket and detains them until the car's real owner arrives.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
